entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One mouse, sbj<N>-<yymmdd>, the start of the cell identity. The same string is the internalIdentifier of the subject in the EBRAINS Knowledge Graph and the subject folder name in the morphology dataset of the same neuron (dorst-2019-morphology).

entityTypes.name: cell
entityTypes.description: One recorded cholinergic interneuron. The dataset holds one cell, sbj4-170614_cell6_original__md_20170614_cell_5_6_ChIN; the descriptor calls this name the identity and does not break it down.

cell_id.name: cell_id
cell_id.title: Cell identity
cell_id.description: Name of the cell's folder, as the data descriptor's <identity>.

dataLocations.description: Dorst et al., electrophysiological recordings of a striatal cholinergic interneuron (dataset version 7d545473-405d-45f9-b0c4-05b627bf793a, bucket pc0a33-hbp-d000009_ChIN-ephys_pub). The data descriptor's layout is 2019Q3/<cell type>/<analysis|derived|original>/<identity>; this location is the derived branch of 2019Q3, with one root per cell-type folder (chin), and holds the derived traces per cell, ASCII text. Every entry below the roots was listed.

filePatterns.name: traces
filePatterns.description: One trace per channel and sweep, <condition>_<protocol>_ch<N>_<sweep>. Even channels hold the current in pA, odd channels the voltage in mV; time in ms.
